alerts.headline: Slack于2026-08-24正式发布'Slack Code'——项目制代码频道，人与多个外部AI coding agent（Claude Code、Devin、GitHub Copilot、ChatGPT、Vercel）在同一共享频道内协作写代码，代码diff与live preview对所有人可见，面向全部Slack套餐开放
alerts.evidence: 「bring teams and AI agents into a dedicated space to write, review, and ship code」「work directly with...Claude Code, Devin, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, and Vercel agents—in a shared, central space」「code diffs, and live previews are visible to everyone」
alerts.action_suggestion: 建议密切关注Slack Code的多AI-agent协作场景是否进一步演进为跨owner的live artifact pull（而非仅限单一Slack工作区内的共享频道），并评估meee2菜单栏peripheral层与Slack Code'共享central space'定位的差异化沟通角度；Dreamforce 2026(9/15-9/17)期间可能有后续公告，建议下轮重点跟进。
